title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Commercial Census - CommercialSpace
description: A physical place prepared for selling products, providing services, or serving customers, such as a shop, premises or office (edintcom:CommercialSpace, subclass of edint-infraestructura's Facility).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CommercialSpace'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

identifier.description: Property. A human-readable code identifying the space in the source data (dct:identifier), e.g. 'COM-0001'.

belongsToCommercialAggregation.description: Relationship. The CommercialAggregation this space belongs to, if any, e.g. a shopping center or market (edintcom:belongsToCommercialAggregation).

hasTerrace.description: Relationship. Terrace(s) this commercial space has (edintcom:hasTerrace).

hasCommercialSpaceStatus.description: Property. The space's current status, from the CommercialSpaceStatus controlled vocabulary (edintcom:hasCommercialSpaceStatus).

hasAccessType.description: Property. How the space is accessed, from the AccessType controlled vocabulary (edintcom:hasAccessType). NOTE: not declared as a formal property in the source's own ontology.ttl (only its KOS concept scheme is published), but is used in the source's own real example data; included per that real usage.

locatedInZone.description: Relationship. The zone this commercial space is located in (edintcom:locatedInZone).
